name: io.github.r0dell/market-data-mcp
title: Market Data (x402)
description: Paid-per-call market data for agents: trading calendars, futures, macro, contract specs (x402)

environmentVariables.name: X402_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file with the private key of a small, dedicated payment wallet (plain text or JSON with private_key). Without it only free tools work.

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Alternative to X402_KEY_FILE: private key of a small, dedicated payment wallet.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_USDC_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Highest price per call in USDC

environmentVariables.name: MAX_USDC_PER_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Total budget per server start in USDC
